title: Rewards
intro: Review gift card rewards, check risk signals, and resolve delivery problems. Every decision needs a note for the audit log.

budgets.title: Program budgets
budgets.intro: Committed includes rewards from pending through delivered. Delivered is part of the committed amount.

tableCaption: Rewards, booking context, risk signals, and available decisions
emptyBody: Rewards appear here when they need a decision or help with delivery. Choose all rewards to see other grants.

descriptions.approve_review: This makes the gift card reward available for the helper to redeem.
descriptions.reject_review: The helper won't get this gift card. Your note explains why the reward was rejected.
descriptions.void: The helper won't get this gift card. Your note explains why the reward was voided.
descriptions.reissue: This requests another delivery of the gift card after a delivery problem.

decision.noteHint: Use 10–1,000 characters. This note is kept in the audit log.
decision.tooShort: Enter a note of at least 10 characters.
decision.tooLong: Keep the note to 1,000 characters or fewer.
decision.notAllowed: You can't make this decision now. Your role may not allow it, or the reward may have changed. Refresh the page to check.

previews.unknown: Reward decision could not be saved
previews.previewNote: Checked the booking and account signals before recording this decision.
